integ.contract_notes:
Contract v2 (docs/MODULE_GUIDE.md) is unchanged and test_module_guide is green. Everything below is an addition or a gate behaviour the plan mandates.

(1) Provider token bucket (P334): HttpClient now spends quota.reserve's wait before every request to a provider's hosts. That includes ctx.data downloads of the provider, which share the bucket. The longest accepted wait is max(quota.RATE_WAIT_MAX = 15 s, one provider interval = 1/(rate_per_second x safety_margin)), still bounded by the run deadline. Anything longer is RATE_LIMITED 'could not verify now', never an absence. A module making two requests to a slow provider needs a timeout above one interval. Known limit: a slot reserved and then refused for lack of time is not released.

(2) LINT-07: a P145 schema keep path may name a password-FORM carrier (password_risk/passwordRisk/password_type/password_algorithm...; lint.is_password_form_carrier). The sanitizer renames it password_form or drops it.

(3) LINT-03 flags SMTP-probe APIs (smtp-check, smtpVerify, smtp_test, smtp-probe...). '_smtp._tls' DNS names are fine.

(4) scope.PLACEHOLDER_REFS equals policy.AUTH_REF_PLACEHOLDERS: confirmed, yes, ok, none, n/a, test, tbd, todo, xxx, null, true, authorized.

(5) Profile-site specs (A5) need their provider fragment to declare http_profile.concurrency 1. specs.AUTO_DISABLE_DAYS is health.SPEC_DISABLE_DAYS.

(6) POL-03: gated --offline runs make third_party/internal/target modules (DoH-only ones included) UNAVAILABLE 'offline'. Ungated Engine.run_module keeps the wave-1 'ERROR could not verify' DoH behaviour.

(7) Engine passes reason_code to health.record_run; BLOCKED 'circuit'/'hostile_host' runs are neutral for demotion.

(8) The contact guard reads graph collections through snapshots (thread-safe for redirect hops).

(9) CTI labels whose literal matches brute[-_ ]?forc (e.g. the tag 'bruteforce') trip LINT-09 and need a justified pragma.

(10) Orphan wave-1 tests (test_links, test_noise, test_datasets, test_entity_types_v2) now tolerate module-batch data fragments (pivot packs, warninglists, essential datasets, platforms). Batch data may grow those registries freely.

fixes: v3lum/core/policy.py (WP07), _consensus: the contact guard's consensus check iterated the live node.tags set, the findings list and graph.correlations directly. Redirect hops run the guard in module worker threads while the engine thread grows the case graph, so a set changed during iteration raised RuntimeError. That ended as a spurious fail-closed refusal: BLOCKED hostile_host, or a redirect not followed. It now copies each collection through _snapshot, as _node_tags already did. Regression test tests/test_policy_guard.py::test_guard_reads_live_graph_collections_through_snapshots fails without the fix (checked by temporarily reverting) and passes with it.

v3lum/core/engine.py (WP08), Engine._decide/_guard: when policy.decide or contact_guard raised, the exception text was logged raw. It is now logged as the type name plus the message passed through redact.redact_text (AR01: no key values in logs).

v3lum/core/lint.py (WP09), LINT-01: module sources that use the v1 ad-hoc dataset form are now flagged. That form is ctx.data.fetch/fetch_text/fetch_json/fetch_lines(name, url) with a second positional argument or a url= that is not None. It downloads from a URL outside the registry, with no host check and no licence/terms class for the policy gate (A1/A6). This was the WP07 reviewer's carry-forward item, still open after integration. Runtime behaviour is unchanged because MODULE_GUIDE section 9 still documents the form. The shipped tree stays lint-clean; no module uses the form. Test: tests/test_lint.py::test_lint01_ad_hoc_dataset_downloads_in_modules. Documented in docs/contract_additions/WP09.md ('Writing a module that passes the lint').

Verified with probes, no change needed. Every plan public_api name resolves; Scope.sha256 is an instance attribute. Each acceptance criterion has a real test (only-gate grep, InternetDB licence skip plus manual link, policy.decide spy, cancel within 2 s, the AR06 regressions, the 12-thread quota test, purge plus tombstone, spec host restriction). A policy.decide sweep over every registered module x sample entity x TLP x seed/pivot x purpose found no violation of: non-open sources allowed under the corporate profile, publishes_queries, LIGHT/ACTIVE in passive mode, PERSONAL_TYPES without a purpose, secrets to non-'none' modules, third_party at RED, unknown-tier or reuses_queries providers at AMBER+, non-trusted providers at AMBER+STRICT, or run_on 'seeds' on pivots. JWT seeds and pivots, including keys inside seed_tlp, unconfirmed_seeds and subject_roles, stay redacted in case.to_dict and in evidence files and names. Combos and tokens in exception messages and res.error are scrubbed in coverage and events. LIGHT target requests carry the browser UA, drop Authorization and Cookie (fail closed) and refuse POST. Text-blob pivots land in pending_personal and LIGHT refuses pivots. Every file and directory under the home is 0600/0700 after a scan and a save. The sanitizer masks or drops AWS, GitHub, Slack and Stripe keys, JWTs, PEM keys, connection-string userinfo, .env values, Basic auth and password keys in any case. No TLS-bypass flag exists anywhere in v3lum; subprocess is used only in core/tools.py.
open_defects: Module batches G10-3 / p2-G10-3 with POL-14 (WP07). p2-G10-3's cnpj_name_resolver, still being written, registers the large, essential dataset cvm_cia_aberta.csv on cvm.SOURCE. G10-3's bcb_authorized_institutions also lists that source. POL-14 links every registered dataset of a module's sources to that module, so bcb_authorized_institutions is UNAVAILABLE 'dataset' until cvm_cia_aberta.csv is downloaded, even though it never reads it. This breaks tests/modules/test_bcb_authorized_institutions.py::test_policy_gate_keeps_missing_datasets_out_of_scans and ::test_scan_runs_offline_and_sends_nothing, and tests/modules/test_typosquat.py::test_bcb_rows_and_dataset_discovery. The batch owners should resolve it: give the dataset its own registry source, or have the bcb test install it. If the architect wants datasets tied to the module that registers them rather than to the whole source, that is a WP07 policy refinement with a contract addition.

datasets.py (WP04 file, no wave-2 owner; architect decision). At runtime, ctx.data.fetch(name, url) with an unregistered name still downloads from any URL during a scan, outside host checks and the licence gate. The frozen MODULE_GUIDE section 9 documents this form as still working, so refusing it during scans needs an architect-approved contract migration. Until then the WP09 lint flags it in modules, and through lint_tree(path) in plugins and specs.

dns.py (WP04 carry, raised by the WP11 reviewer, still open): Resolver._send does not pass ttl_from, so cached DoH answers ignore the DNS record TTL. datasets.py _download still buffers up to 200 MB instead of using stream_to. Neither is a safety issue.

WP20 (wave 4): case.links can hold two entries for the same URL, the P311 manual-link fallback (note 'automation skipped: <code>', manual=True) and the pack link, because engine._add_link deduplicates on (url, label, note). Renderers should merge them. Cosmetic.

Carried forward and confirmed still open: WP17/WP13 must call sanitize.scrub_text on text_blob/file seeds before storing them (P145 cond 5; the raw text stays on the seed node and in pending_personal parent keys inside the 0600 case JSON). WP19 scoring must skip context_only findings. WP08 design limits remain as documented: a later TLP marking is not pushed down to children created earlier; path_confidence is not re-evaluated after a node is discovered; internal_seed is set only from literal private/internal names.
audit.contract_notes: No contract v2 name was renamed and no frozen behaviour changed. tests/test_module_guide.py passes, and every new ctx-facing name is either in MODULE_GUIDE or in docs/contract_additions/WP07..WP12.md; each doc names its package's public_api additions. Behaviours added in this audit: (1) LINT-01 now flags the v1 ad-hoc dataset download form ctx.data.fetch*(name, url) in module, plugin and spec sources. Module authors call register_dataset(...) in the module file and fetch by name; the runtime still accepts the form, as guide section 9 says. Documented in docs/contract_additions/WP09.md. (2) The contact guard reads the live case graph through snapshots, so a racing graph update never causes a spurious hostile_host refusal on redirect hops. (3) Engine policy-failure log lines are redacted. Note for module batches: POL-14 ties every large registered dataset of a source to every module that lists that source. If two batches share a registry source and one adds a large dataset, the other module becomes UNAVAILABLE 'dataset' until that dataset is downloaded. Use distinct source ids when the datasets are independent. Wave 3 is already wired as WP08 requires: app.py calls Store.record_cache_keys and record_report_paths, and v3lum run goes through Engine.decide_single then run_module(decision=).
